summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of BitBot Pro Phase 2 & 3 UI restructure. All 8 test scenarios passed (100%). New navigation with Org/Bot selectors, new pages (BotList, BotOverview, ConnectedAccounts, IntegrationsPage), connection detail view with tabs, and legacy route backward compatibility all working correctly.

issues: Console warning about <span> inside <option> - appears to be React DevTools instrumentation, not actual code issue

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.js: Well-structured sidebar with proper data-testid attributes for all nav items
AuthContext.js: Properly handles v2 org/bot state with localStorage persistence and auto-selection
BotList.js: Clean implementation with bot cards showing connection counts and knowledge gate
BotOverview.js: Inline edit for bot name works correctly with save/cancel buttons
ConnectedAccounts.js: Provider selector (Discord/Telegram/Zendesk) with credential forms working
IntegrationsPage.js: Connection cards with response mode badges, toggle functionality, and detail view with tabs (Connection/Behaviour/Activity)
v2api.js: Clean API helper with proper header management for org-scoped requests
Legacy routes properly maintained for backward compatibility
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 & 3 UI fully tested. Key data-testids: org-switcher, bot-switcher, nav-overview, nav-bots, nav-connected-accounts, nav-team-&-access, nav-bot-overview, nav-behaviour, nav-knowledge-base, nav-integrations, nav-conversations, nav-playground, nav-provider-apps, nav-workspaces-&-users, nav-analytics, nav-api-key-usage. Pages: bot-list-page, connected-accounts-page, integrations-page, bot-overview-page, connection-detail-page. Bot cards: bot-card-{bot_id}. Account cards: account-card-{account_id}. Connection cards: connection-card-{conn_id}. Toggle buttons: toggle-connection-{conn_id}. Create buttons: create-bot-btn, add-account-btn, add-connection-btn. Provider selectors: select-provider-discord, select-provider-telegram, select-provider-zendesk. Response modes: mode-auto_reply, mode-agent_assist, mode-internal_note, mode-sidebar_only.
